$comment: Lakshly sources catalog for the public apps. Hand-written for this repo: institution names and public sender domains are matching rules only. It holds password FORMAT descriptions, never values. Domains with verified:null are best-effort and should be confirmed before relying on them.

passwordHintFormats.customer_id: Your customer ID / CRN (as on your passbook or welcome letter)
passwordHintFormats.name4_ddmm: First 4 letters of your name in capitals, then your birth day and month (DDMM)
passwordHintFormats.dob_ddmmyyyy: Your date of birth as DDMMYYYY
passwordHintFormats.dob_ddmmyyyy_card_last4: Your date of birth (DDMMYYYY) followed by the last 4 digits of the card
passwordHintFormats.mobile_last5_dob: Last 5 digits of your registered mobile number, then your date of birth (DDMMYY)
passwordHintFormats.cas_chosen: The password you chose when you requested the CAS
passwordHintFormats.name4_dob_ddmm: First 4 letters of your name (the email says upper or lower case) followed by your birth day and month as DDMM.
passwordHintFormats.name4_card_last4: First 4 letters of the name on the card followed by the last 4 digits of the card.
passwordHintFormats.mobile_last5_dob_ddmmyy: Last 5 digits of your registered mobile number followed by your date of birth as DDMMYY.
passwordHintFormats.crn: Your CRN (customer relationship number), as shown in the bank's app or alert emails.

guides.gmail: Open the email, ⋮ ▸ Download message saves it as .eml; or download the PDF attachment directly.
guides.outlook: Open the email ▸ … ▸ Save as, or download the PDF attachment.
guides.appleMail: Drag the PDF attachment to Finder, or on iPhone tap it ▸ Share ▸ Save to Files.
